free_tier.stated: CodeSandbox Free: "Every Free workspace gets 400 free monthly credits ... it's enough to develop a small React web app for 40 hours per month on a Nano VM", quoted, with "access to 20 Sandboxes for the entire workspace"

egress.terms: not published: the pricing page and the subscriptions page state no egress allowance and no overage price; limits are on credits, VMs and SDK requests

interface_detail: CLI, per the CodeSandbox SDK CLI page: "The CodeSandbox SDK provides a command-line interface (CLI) called `csb` for managing sandboxes, templates, and configurations."
tooling: the csb command-line interface of the CodeSandbox SDK, per the CLI page: "The CodeSandbox SDK provides a command-line interface (CLI) called `csb`"
chaining: 40 Nano-VM hours a month is a free headless Linux box with a filesystem and a port, which is what a build, a scrape or a test run needs; it is the cheapest server-shaped free tier per credit, and it composes with any static host for the output.

limits.value: the 400 monthly credits run out before anything else, and every VM and repository in the workspace then enters a frozen state until the next billing cycle.

evidence.proved: "Every Free workspace gets 400 free monthly credits ... it's enough to develop a small React web app for 40 hours per month on a Nano VM" and "the Free tier also provides access to 20 Sandboxes", quoted
"A workspace on the free plan gets 400 credits per month" and unused credits do not roll over, quoted
"VM credits ... are priced at $0.015 each", quoted, so 400 free credits is USD 6 of VM runtime at list price
rate limits on the Free (Build) plan were doubled from 5 to 10 concurrent VMs, quoted; the same post records the Together AI acquisition
a third party recorded that between 2026-09-07 and 2026-09-14 the Build plan lost the bullet '40 hours of monthly VM credits', reported
the plan table limits requests, VMs and credits; no egress allowance or overage price appears

notes: The credits are worth USD 6 a month at the vendor's own rate, which is small in dollars and large in hours because a Nano VM is one vCPU. The pricing page and the docs disagree: the 40-hour bullet was removed from the pricing page in September 2026 while the docs still state 400 credits, so the allowance may be mid-change. compute/codesandbox-sdk already records the SDK from Together AI's docs, not this free tier; merge into one CodeSandbox record. Browser Sandboxes do not consume credits, so the 20-Sandbox allowance is a separate and unmetered free lane.
